    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayCheckLater" name="Display check-again-later message" sourceRef="Task_DisplayCheckLaterMessage" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Present immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_ImmediateScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayLevel2Result" name="Present level 2 scoring result" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_Level2ScoringResult"/>
